question_text: What was the net person flow (person_entry events minus person_exit events) at Gate_MainEntrance on 2025-12-08 (UTC)?

gold.sql: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN event_type='person_entry' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN event_type='person_exit' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS net_flow FROM events WHERE camera_location='Gate_MainEntrance' AND event_type IN ('person_entry','person_exit') AND timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'

metadata.note: Conditional aggregation (CASE WHEN) for net flow. Should be small absolute number since exit_ratio is configured at 0.45 (slight inflow bias).
